artifact.summary: Implemented xv6 syscall lab in /app/syscall: (1) trace syscall with per-process tracemask (kernel/proc.h field, inherited in fork at proc.c:312), sys_trace in sysproc.c, dispatch+printf in syscall.c with syscallnames table; (2) sysinfo syscall returning freemem (kalloc.c freemem_amount) and nproc (proc.c nproc_count) via copyout, with struct sysinfo in kernel/sysinfo.h; (3) user-space stubs trace()/sysinfo() in user/user.h and user/usys.pl; (4) time.txt created. Verified in QEMU: 'trace 32 grep hello README' prints only read syscalls, 'trace 2147483647 grep hello README' prints all syscalls, 'trace 2 usertests forkforkfork' prints fork traces and ALL TESTS PASSED, and 'sysinfotest: OK'. Known limitation: usertests 'copyout' test fails, but that is a pre-existing xv6 issue in read/write bad-address handling unrelated to the trace/sysinfo syscalls.
